notes: This is al-Faqih's statement of his routes («فقد رويته عن ...») to Aban ibn Uthman, with no saying: needs_ruling by rule 11.
Each «؛» separates a route. The head «محمد بن الحسن» is written once and is repeated in the first four groups; the fifth route (Safwan) does not repeat it, so it is written as the text gives it.
«كلهم عن محمد بن أبي عمير» makes Ibn Abi Umayr the shared level of the third and fourth routes; the text does not name the link after Ya'qub or Ayyub.
«- رضي اللّه عنه -» is a blessing and is left out.
